landing.hero_subtitle: Say goodbye to reading lengthy documents. Upload any document, and NexusLearn's AI will instantly build a Mind Map, Flashcards, and a personalized learning path just for you.
landing.bento_title: Not just summaries — it's knowledge creation.
landing.bento_subtitle: NexusLearn transforms dry text into visual, easy-to-understand, and memorable knowledge pieces.
landing.card1_desc: NexusLearn's core technology automatically extracts and draws a network of concepts. You will always know what to study first, what to study next, and how they connect to each other.
landing.card2_desc: Automatically generate flashcards and detailed lectures based on levels from basic to advanced.
landing.card3_desc: Every Quiz result and lesson progress is recorded, helping to motivate you to overcome learning challenges every day.
landing.step1_desc: Supports PDF, Text, or direct text pasting.
landing.step2_desc: Gemini will read, analyze, and extract the knowledge structure.
landing.step3_desc: Explore the Knowledge map and unlock each lecture level.
landing.cta_desc: Be the first to experience systematized AI education. Join now for free.
